text:
sara_cs: Quick weekly check for NewCo — onboarding week 4. TL;DR: token volume dipped WoW, QoQ still positive; latency p95 spiked; 429s bump in error rate; spend creeping up. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/newco/health

paul_se: saw the spike this morning too. They flipped to the larger model variant last Tue per notes. Could be batching + longer seqs.

mira_eng: do we have a breakdown by route? chat vs embeddings?

analytics-bot: embeddings: 11.2M tokens (-4% WoW), chat: 31.1M tokens (-11% WoW). QoQ total +19%. p50 latency stable (~85ms), p95 increased to 420ms from 220ms last week. Error rate 1.2% (mostly 429).

sara_cs: copying convo from the enablement call — they started a new feature that hits long-history context + streaming. Could explain KV pressure.

jon_ops: there was a small infra canary yesterday that bumped queueing on one zone for ~40m around 10:14 UTC. I rolled it back but might have correlated with p95.

paul_se: If it's long-history, enabling prefix caching for their chat route could cut tokens and latency a lot. Also check model quantization profile — they were on fp16 large variant.

mira_eng: I can push a guarded change to enable prefix/KV cache and adjust max_length for streaming to 8k -> 4k for canary customers. Will need a config flag and a small eval.

sara_cs: Action items: 1) mira to roll canary prefix cache + limit, 2) paul to confirm model variant rollback or alt variant, 3) jon to re-check infra logs for 10:00-11:00 UTC window, 4) I'll prep a short customer note about expected perf improvements. :thumbsup:

mira_eng: assigning to myself. Will run a 2-hour canary tomorrow 09:00 PST and post results here.

jon_ops: digging logs now, will upload the snippet.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: mira_eng/prefix-cache-toggle -> canary (NewCo) at 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z.

sara_cs: thanks team. If we see errors fall <0.5% and p95 <250ms we can recommend permanent change + update runbook.

paul_se: noted. Also flag finance: spend trending +12% QoQ (estimate $1.4k/day) — might hit renewal discussions if not stabilized.

analytics-bot: Quick metric snapshot (week):
```
NewCo — Weekly snapshot
tokens_total: 42.3M (-9% WoW, +18% QoQ)
p50_latency: 85ms
p95_latency: 420ms (prev 220ms)
error_rate: 1.2% (429s spike)
avg_cost_per_day: $1,420 (+12% QoQ)
active_users: 6.3k (+6% QoQ)
```

sara_cs: perfect — I'll include this in the renewal health packet and sync with AM next Tue.

paul_se: adding a quick note: ask NewCo if any recent prompt template changes — long system messages + full-history echo can explode token counts.

mira_eng: will add prompt auditing to canary checklist.

sara_cs: closing the loop: please paste canary results and infra log snippet here after tests. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
